messages.content:
Hi everyone,

I’d like to share our paper, Trace-Tree Magmas: Proof-Producing Infinite Countermodels and 28 New Order-Five Austin Classifications:

Read the paper on arXiv

We introduce a family of infinite magmas built from finite constructor trees. The operation normally pairs its arguments, with exceptions determined by symbolic evaluation traces. Our system searches for these constructions and generates Lean certificates verifying the resulting countermodels.

The paper reports 28 new order-five Austin classifications, representing 14 duality classes. These identities admit nontrivial infinite models even though all their finite models are trivial. Code and reproducibility artifacts are linked from the paper.

We’d welcome questions, independent checks, and comparisons with other constructions—especially connections to countermodels others have found.

Many thanks to everyone in the equational theories community for the shared problems, tools, and discussions!
messages.subject: New Order-5 Austin Laws

messages.content:
Beyond those 32, we now have certificates for 24 additional order-five Austin laws, forming the following 12 dual pairs:

Identity / Dual identity

Equation5833 / Equation40070
Equation6878 / Equation39126
Equation7763 / Equation38565
Equation9603 / Equation36514
Equation11205 / Equation35100
Equation11280 / Equation34778
Equation12073 / Equation33998
Equation12857 / Equation33436
Equation13764 / Equation32294
Equation13849 / Equation32281
Equation13992 / Equation32280
Equation18212 / Equation27859

These identities have only trivial finite models, while the certificates establish the existence of nontrivial infinite models.

We also obtained Lean proofs of two TRUE implications:

  • Equation5834 → Equation2
  • Equation40037 → Equation2

Here, Equation2 is the identity \(x=y\). These two laws therefore force every model—not merely every finite model—to be trivial, so they are not Austin laws.

The certificates for all 24 Austin laws and both TRUE implications have been accepted by our Judge v3. The Lean proofs and accompanying materials are publicly available here:

GitHub: Order5-Austin-Law-Proofs

A note on prior work: Equation12857 and Equation33436 already appear in the ALPS historical results; our contribution for these two is independent certification. “Additional” refers to identities beyond our paper’s collection, rather than a claim that all 24 are first discoveries.

Independent checks, questions, and feedback are very welcome!
